headline: AEWM reports agent-state editing gains across six benchmarks and three model sizes
summary: A 2026 arXiv paper proposes an Agent-Editing World Model (AEWM) that judges whether an agent’s proposed reasoning-action pair is critical, exploratory or noisy, then revises noisy proposals before executing them against real tools. In the authors’ three-run evaluations, EditAct improves average scores over the strongest baseline by 6.7, 5.2 and 3.2 points for Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B across six search, terminal and software-engineering benchmarks. A held-out 3,000-decision Action Judge benchmark reports 70.5% macro-F1 versus 59.9% for DeepSeek-V4-Pro. These are paper-reported results; independent replication and cost accounting remain open.
